Functionally annotated DEPs mapped onto major pathways affected by 6PPD-Q, including glycolysis and the TCA cycle

Functionally annotated DEPs mapped onto major pathways affected by 6PPD-Q, including glycolysis and the TCA cycle. Red round boxes indicate upregulated proteins, and blue round boxes indicate downregulated proteins. Yellow round boxes indicate significantly regulated proteins. Protein names and full gene designations are as follows: tpm1 (tropomyosin-1), mybpc1 (myosin-binding protein C), dspa (desmoplakin a), scp2a (sterol carrier protein 2), fads2 (fatty acid desaturase 2), cept1a (choline/ethanolamine phosphotransferase 1a), mtmr7 (myotubularin-related protein 7), dgkaa (diacylglycerol kinase alpha a), LOC109111832 (sterol 14alpha-demethylase), ak6 (adenylate kinase isoenzyme 6), entpd2a.2 (Ectonucleoside triphosphate diphosphohydrolase), dao.2 (D-amino acid oxidase), amy (Alpha-amylase), mdh1 (malate dehydrogenase), cox7c (cytochrome c oxidase subunit 7c), olah (S-acyl fatty acid synthase thioesterase, medium chain isoform 1), ca4 (carbonic anhydrase 4), and haao (3-hydroxyanthranilate 3,4-dioxygenase)
Download JPG

Publication

Adverse effects of 6PPD-quinone bioaccumulation at environmentally relevant concentrations on Cyprinus carpio growth and development (2026) Yooeun Chae, et al. Sci Rep. 2026;16(NA). Figure: F4.
